description: Dataset for Rice Irrigation System is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors miftah walid, Muhammad Ashar (Universitas Negeri Malang). This dataset can be used to present several key innovations in the development of an AI-IoT-based Smart Irrigation System specifically designed for rice plants by considering local agronomic characteristics. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
